quantization.assumption: Bounds assume each underlying amount is encoded with at most one ULP error; not a vendor guarantee or full source-statistics error bound.

closing_quantity_inference.interpretation: Inferred under fixed closing-match price and amount error <= one encoding ULP; not an observed exchange quantity or proof of rounding algorithm.

conclusions.primary_mechanism: End-point prices times aggregated interval volume differ from sums of actual execution price times quantity.
conclusions.secondary_mechanism_inferred: Whole-lot source quantity granularity; fixed-price closing amount suggests 45 additional shares.
conclusions.unresolved: No per-interval real turnover or exchange trade IDs in 0fc6; intra-record price weighting and exact quantity rounding cannot be uniquely recovered.
